signal: Sonatype named Vertosoft a value-added distributor to expand reach across federal, state and local government agencies

email.body1:
Thomas, saw Sonatype add Vertosoft to widen reach across federal, state, and local agencies.

When the addressable list expands, the bottleneck is rarely intent data, it is signal-to-action latency: by the time a rep acts on a signal, the moment has passed. Our AI SDR turns signals into researched, personalized outreach automatically, so the team converts more of the same data: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Sonatype off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress around 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Thomas, quick follow-up for Sonatype.

Most RevOps teams I talk to know exactly where the funnel leaks but cannot get reps to act on signals fast enough, and data hygiene eats the hours that should go to follow-up. That latency is usually the single biggest measurable drag on conversion.

Worth 15 minutes? I will walk you through a teardown of your current outbound, three things I would change. Our best practices alone usually lift response rates 50 to 70 percent.
email.body3:
Thomas, last bit of proof for Sonatype.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Sonatype's reply rate likely compares to peer security vendors. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your ops motion? I will tailor it to Sonatype either way.
